purpose.zh: 练托马斯全旋需要的单手单脚侧撑力量
purpose.en: Build the one-hand, one-foot side support you need for flares.

text.zh: 下面的手和脚撑地，身体接近水平
text.en: Push through your bottom hand and foot with your body almost level

text.zh: 上面的腿抬起，另一只手向上伸直。
text.en: Lift your top leg and reach your free arm straight up.

text.zh: 撑地的手推地，肩膀远离耳朵。
text.en: Push the floor away so your shoulder stays away from your ear.

commonErrors.en: Letting your shoulder sink toward your ear.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时缩短时间，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrist or shoulder hurts, hold for less time, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 主口令「同侧手和下方脚」改成「下面的手和脚」
training=hold（每侧计时）；动画是静止侧撑只有呼吸起伏，批表的 2 次是呼吸
